evals.name: switch-to-postgres
evals.prompt: Switch us from SQLite to Postgres. Nothing in production is worth keeping.
evals.expected_output: pgx stdlib driver, modernc removed, goose postgres dialect, sqlc postgresql engine, per-test databases in testutil, CI postgres service, compose postgres service with password from env, stateless image, docs and skills updated, tests pass against a real server.
assertions: db.Open uses github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib through database/sql and still returns *sql.DB
Errors from db.Open don't include the DSN (no password leak)
testutil gives each test its own fresh Postgres database and drops it afterwards
Tests that run serve pass a Postgres URL instead of a SQLite file
ci.yml go job has a postgres service container
compose.yml adds a postgres service with a named volume and the password taken from an env var, not hardcoded
Dockerfile no longer creates /data or sets APP_DB to a SQLite file
SQLite/WAL statements are removed from AGENTS.md and the this-project skill
go test ./... passes against a real Postgres server
